title: Kusikiliza kwa Kina (Theme 9: Matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika mawasiliano)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child hears the one feature that separates /d/ na /nd/ and checks the meaning of the word before writing it.

floor.prerequisite: Says the five vowels and reads open syllables (ba, be, bi, bo, bu).
floor.question: Soma: do-a

representations: a hand on the throat to feel the voice (or the lips for a nasal)
a picture for each meaning (a stain, a marriage)
steps: Think of the meaning in the sentence.
Write it and read it back.
contexts: a word game in the playground

board.do: Point at the first letter of each word.
board.say: Neno lipi lina maana ya "a stain"?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes both words under their pictures and says each one.

misconceptions.ask: Neno "doa" lina maana gani, na "ndoa" lina maana gani?
misconceptions.repair: "doa" ni a stain; "ndoa" ni a marriage. Sauti moja hubadilisha maana.
Neno lenye maana ya "draughts (the board game)" ni "dama". "ndama" lina maana ya "a calf".

misconceptions.ask: Ukibadilisha neno moja kwa jingine katika sentensi, maana inabaki ileile?
misconceptions.repair: Hapana. "dama" ni draughts (the board game), na "ndama" ni a calf.

listen_for: Simu yangu mpya ina kamera nzuri.
misconceptions.ask: Ni sauti gani zinarudiwa katika sentensi hii?
misconceptions.repair: Kitanzandimi hurudia sauti zinazokaribiana, kama /d/ na /nd/, ili kiwe kigumu kutamka.

misconceptions.ask: Kila silabi inaishia kwa herufi gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: ndo-a.

checks.question: Andika neno lenye maana ya "a calf".
Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?
checks.answer: Ndege wa Dadi alidondoka ndani ya ndoo ya dada.
